payload.description:
**Blocked by:** nothing.

hey.chattic.us and staging.chattic.us currently answer unauthenticated requests from the open internet; ChatticusThinTurnProduction returns environment production on /api/health today. Neither environment needs to serve anyone before this initiative ships, so they should not be reachable. Development stays up because the work happens there.

**Done when:** the staging and production web stacks no longer serve, the decision is recorded on this issue, and the redeploy is tracked under the promotion epic.
payload.title: Take staging and production dark until authentication lands
